title: The email switch affects email only, the inbox and bell are always on
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. A second user who can sign in and has access to a work order; you will tag them on a note: on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView"). Reading their email needs a mailbox you can open for that user; the QA quick-login addresses cannot be opened by a tester, so the email half cannot be done by hand on a QA branch (left to automation) - do the inbox and bell half.
custom_steps:
1. As the second user, turn Email notifications ON and save; have someone tag them on a note; check their email and inbox.
  2. Turn Email notifications OFF and save; tag them on another note; check their email, inbox and bell count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With "Email notifications" on, the user receives an email when they are a recipient of a note; with it off, they receive no such email.
  • In-app delivery (the inbox and the bell count) is always on and cannot be turned off - it works either way.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10251 (S8, Set notification preferences); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S8; design board Preferences; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R6: “With "Email notifications" on, the user receives an email when they are a recipient of a note.”
  • S8-R7: “With "Email notifications" off, the user receives no email when they are a recipient of a note.”
  • S8-R8: “In-app delivery (the inbox and the bell count) is always on and cannot be turned off.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
